text: Your Pokémon can build your whole house. Block by block, from a Litematica plan.
Types pick the crew. Fighters build fastest, flyers do the roof.
At level fifty, Machop fells a whole tree in one swing.
Ten jobs: lumber, mining, farming, building, guarding, crafting and more.
Draw a patrol, and your guards keep it safe.
Unlock forty-nine upgrades as your crew grows.
